supersededPreparations.reason: Root screenshot-order correction arrived immediately after binding; preserved bound a1 and prepared a2 before browser launch.

attempts.interpretation: Actual executed a2 failed both whole cases. EN exposed a real static-cue position regression: no dock caused a cue with floating=false to use preferred floating placement; the separately bound runtime amendment corrects that expression. RU reached the later Search-close observation, but Search state before help collapse was not recorded, so this evidence cannot establish a Search product bug. Successful earlier assertions do not turn either whole case into a pass.

Actual executed a3 passed both whole cases. It retains the strict EN static-position/no-approach invariant against the separately bound position fix. Both locales recorded Search open with its input focused before explicit help collapse and Search closed with avatar focus afterward; no extra later toggle occurred. This supports the observer correction and does not claim a Search runtime fix. Outcome and individual case status come exclusively from the original report; this diagnostic does not replace final validation.

limitations: Bound a1 was superseded before any preflight or browser execution and is not counted as a failed test. Actual executed attempts retain their original whole-case outcomes.
The a2 EN position jump is a reproduced runtime bug; RU Search state before help collapse was unrecorded, so no RU Search product bug is inferred.
Only recorded flags and check data are preserved as subobservations. Passing earlier assertions or diagnostic captures do not replace a passing whole case or final committed-source validation.
Historical D201 diagnostic and checkpoint-guard chains are not copied. No D202 unit-startup or checkpoint-guard failure is invented.

Browser loss is API-initiated WEBGL_lose_context on the actual canonical renderer. Drag/pinch execution, stale callback races, native lifecycle, installed-device, full accessibility and stage acceptance remain unclaimed.
Formal browser-a1 remains RU failed/EN passed. Original source manifest and six check inputs are preserved byte-exact in the initial freeze archive.

a4/a5 use explicit read-only bundle instrumentation and do not claim full-case acceptance. a6 RU remains failed despite passing earlier approach/Stop assertions; a7 passes the effective controlled cutoff check.
The supplemental 17-case walking unit run used the pre-cleanup source hashes recorded in its provenance. It is not counted as the final 66-case formal run.
